scope: Focused production/release code review, including the newly added generated Kotlin runtime. SaaS excluded. Not an exhaustive audit or mathematical proof.

findings.title: Generated runtime region arithmetic corrupts cursor state
findings.evidence: Direct Java probes reproduce region(-1) leaving position -1 and region(Int.MAX_VALUE) at position 1 wrapping to Int.MIN_VALUE. The API returns normally.
findings.task: Validate initial positions and nonnegative extents; use checked addition or subtraction-based bounds before changing region state. Audit need(), bytes() and writer address arithmetic too.
findings.completion: Negative, overflow, truncated and nested-region cases reject before mutation; generated-code adversarial tests match the reference contract.

findings.title: Generated runtime alignment silently narrows large values
findings.evidence: align(4294967298L) at position 1 advances to 2 because boundary.toInt() wraps. Confirmed by the probe.
findings.task: Preserve Long arithmetic; validate alignment and resulting position before narrowing. Specify over-container alignment behavior consistently across runtime and engine.
findings.completion: Exact boundary vectors cover 0, negatives, Int.MAX_VALUE, 2^32+2 and overflow; no aliasing to another alignment.

findings.title: Specification CI depends on an absent sibling repository
findings.evidence: The specification workflow checks out only this repository. test_gdal_runtime unconditionally reads ../hexplain-tools. Local success cannot establish clean-checkout CI success.
findings.task: Pin and checkout the required engine revision into the expected sibling path, or validate immutable vendored evidence without a sibling dependency. Audit historical git-object dependencies too.
findings.completion: Run all gates from a fresh Linux checkout without preexisting sibling files; record source revisions and successful CI URL.

findings.title: Published competency traceability is stale
findings.evidence: Fresh targeted run: competency_trace fails exact JSON freshness assertion; gdal_runtime passes locally. Do not remove the guard to make the run green.
findings.task: Regenerate traceability after canonical/reference/corpus changes; inspect semantic differences and normalize hashing policy where line endings matter. Wire generation freshness into authoring checks.
findings.completion: Freshness test passes on Windows and clean Linux with identical committed artifacts and deliberate review of changed coverage.

findings.title: Release acceptance excludes the new codec-generation surface
findings.evidence: settings includes codegen, runtime-kotlin, codegen-kotlin and codegen-verify. Release workflow explicitly tests/stages only core, adapters and HDL; publishing likewise permits only those three. General CI does call build/test, but that does not deliver the standalone runtime.
findings.task: Define which generator/runtime modules are distributable, add their artifacts and consumer tests, and make generated-code verification mandatory before release promotion.
findings.completion: A consumer outside the checkout generates and compiles a codec using private-registry artifacts alone; both OS release jobs test all in-scope modules.

findings.title: Generated runtime does not inherit parser-wide budgets
findings.evidence: ByteReader has no shared work/depth/deadline budget. until retries every prefix; emitted counted loops allocate and iterate without a shared request budget. Per-block codec and writer byte limits do not cover cumulative work. This is static analysis, not a measured denial-of-service exploit.
findings.task: Add an invocation-wide runtime budget spanning regions, recursion, repetitions and cumulative decoding. Use bounded linear terminator search. Audit WriteBuffer doubling for overflow at configured limits above 1 GiB; validate externally killable execution.
findings.completion: Adversarial zero-width repeats, long-prefix sentinels, nested decode expansion and recursive layouts fail within documented work/time limits; deployed worker cancellation and recovery pass.
findings.status: Shared budgets and local Linux process containment verified; deployed service acceptance outside this evidence

findings.title: Live machine-readable publication still fails
findings.evidence: Fresh 8 September probe results are retained separately. Namespace and immutable manifest requests still receive HTML fallback responses.
findings.task: Fix actual hosting routes, negotiated media types and cache behavior; verify every canonical namespace and immutable release.
findings.completion: All live contract probes pass after deployment; unknown routes reject; archive bytes and hashes remain immutable.
findings.status: Deferred by user; excluded from scoring

findings.task: Refresh candidate hashes and requirement-to-test mapping; obtain an attributable independent review of current modules, cross-module constraints, unknown-value semantics and migrations.
findings.completion: Named independent decision against exact hashes; all blocking findings resolved with counterexamples and dual-validator tests.

findings.title: Historical evidence is not current release acceptance
findings.evidence: GitHub history inspected during review shows failures and no successful current-head run in the returned history. Local codegen task invocation succeeds but is up-to-date; only runtime tests were explicitly rerun.
findings.task: Freeze release candidate; execute full clean CI, extend negative/fuzz and real-format semantic differential cases, publish immutable private artifacts, audit transitive dependencies and retain provenance.
findings.completion: Successful current-revision CI and registry install, documented advisory dispositions, signed provenance where supported, and tested rollback. No billing cause is inferred from old annotations.
